lead_headline: Foreclosure filings jump 14% week-over-week to 72—highest weekly count since early February—as Arapahoe's $57M South Vaughn filing anchors $82M total exposure

restaurant.blurb: 3 new leads today hold active roster steady at 53 total (25 openings, 28 closures)—opening side adds Vaultaire's subterranean HiFi lounge debut beneath La Forêt (Speer, launched today), Bad Rabbit Coffee's RiNo brick-and-mortar (Cole, early March soft open after mobile caravan years), and Mendocino Farms' second Denver location (West Highland, opening today at 32nd/Federal). Closure tallies include Aspen Baking's sudden shutdown (Stapleton manufacturer, 30-year wholesale operator ceased March 6 mid-acquisition) and China Jade Seafood's permanent close (Westwood dim sum fixture, 15+ year Federal Boulevard staple). Week's geographic churn: Union Station sees continued rotation (Mendocino, prior GQue/Ogo openings), Cole gains coffee density, Speer adds late-night listening niche. Closures maintain 3-lead advantage—28 vs 25 unchanged from yesterday.

foreclosure.blurb: 72 new filings this week jump 14% from prior week's 63—highest weekly volume since early February breaks five-week decline trajectory. 107 auctions scheduled next seven days hold steady, but $82.2M total exposure spikes on Arapahoe's $57.1M South Vaughn Way filing (single property drives 69% of week's value). Only one other seven-figure case: $2.24M South Columbine Circle (Arapahoe, auction March 13). County landscape shifts: Weld climbs to 431 active cases (overtakes Arapahoe's 415), El Paso still leads at 475. Weekly 72-filing count marks 14% week-over-week gain, reversing multi-week softness—March volatility persists with 30-72 filing band replacing January's 50+ baseline.

reputation.blurb: 3 mentions today pull seven-day total to 40 citations across 10 sources—down 11% from prior week's 45, extending two-week slide despite stabilized daily capture. Denver Post sustains dominance with 17 of 40 pickups (43% share, up from 38% prior week), social platforms aggregate 14 mentions (Facebook 7, Instagram 5, X 2), Hoodline contributes 4. Thursday detections: Ball Arena tunnel finalist story (Instagram), homeless spending analysis (Facebook), Cable Center-DU sale coverage (Post). Week's 40-mention floor matches February lows—Post concentration risk intensifies as single source delivers nearly half total volume. Discovery: Google News RSS captures 100% of 40 pickups. Monthly pace: 115 total projects 153-mention March if sustained through month-end.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +2 yesterday (2 new, 0 canceled) lifts MTD to +33 (+1.7/day), 90-day cumulative at +96. Zero cancellations Thursday mark cleanest retention day since March 7—acquisition steadies at 2-5 daily range as March 9's 8-new surge recedes into baseline. Seven-day window: +17 net (22 new, 5 canceled) matches prior week's +17 exactly, but composition tightens—cancellations compress from 8 to 5 while new subs slip from 25 to 22. March's 1.7/day rate tracks 31% above YTD's 1.3/day benchmark—strongest monthly performance on record. Recent two-week pattern: post-March 9 volatility absorbed, 3-4 net daily baseline established with cancellations contained sub-2/day. Momentum sustains despite acquisition deceleration from 5-day period's 5-8 new range to current 2-4 floor.
